description: For every actual \(L\)-structure \(M\), relational matrix \(A\), and closed-term tuple \(\bar t\), truth of its propositional ground reading under \(b_M\) is equivalent to satisfaction of the actual first-order sentence obtained by filling all its slots.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.actual_instance_truth.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type z}
  [L.Structure M] {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty n)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.RelationalQF φ)
  (ts : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.modelValuation M)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundReading φ ts) =
      true ↔
    M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiateSlots φ ts
